subject: Customer request: Pinning guarantees and purge artifacts for Dedicated deployment
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice@finwell.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pin & purge — what artifacts can you provide?

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week. Our security and legal teams have asked for a concrete list of artifacts and acceptance criteria we can use to validate region pinning and tenant-level purges for the Dedicated environment before we execute the purchase order. Our procurement milestone requires:

- Confirmation that tenant data can be pinned to a single cloud region and that no replica crosses region boundaries.
- A sample logical runbook or checklist showing the steps your ops team takes to confirm a pin.
- Example outputs from a wipe/erase simulation (logs, nonce/timestamped audit entries).
- Clarification on snapshot retention, snapshot storage location, and how you guarantee image deletion.
- An estimate of how long evidence and signed artifacts will take to produce.

Can you provide a pack of artifacts we can hand to our auditors (redacted is fine)? Also please include any SOC2 or ISO-related references that tie to the processes.

We have target signature week of Aug 23; procurement wants everything in by Aug 16.

Thanks,
Alice Park
Security Programs Manager
FinWell
[external]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice@finwell.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pin & purge — what artifacts can you provide?

Hi Alice — thanks, and great question.

We can produce a discrete artifact bundle for auditors. Attached is an initial checklist and a short acceptance-criteria doc that we've used for prior Dedicated customers (redacted). Quick summary of what we'll include:

1) Region confirmation: control-plane export showing tenant -> region mapping, cluster IDs, and routing policy timestamps.
2) Isolation proof: host allocation manifests and ephemeral worker assignment during the pin window.
3) Purge simulation: end-to-end wipe run with timestamped audit rows, KV-cache purge logs, and final verification steps.
4) Snapshot lifecycle: snapshot creation metadata, encryption key IDs (redacted), and a signed deletion event when we remove backups.
5) Chain-of-custody statement signed by our Ops lead and a brief ops playbook excerpt.

Attachments I am dropping here as stubs: [Attachment: pinning-checklist.pdf (PDF, 42KB)], [Attachment: erase-sim-output.log (LOG, 128KB)].

Proposed timeline: our Ops team can perform a verification run and hand over signed artifacts in 7 business days once we get formal approval from your procurement (i.e., after the PO or a short acceptance-of-scope email). That would meet your Aug 16 target if we start the week of Aug 4.

A couple of clarifying asks for your side so we scope correctly:
- Do you require deletion of offline snapshots that may have been replicated to object storage outside the pinned region? (We typically avoid cross-region replication for dedicated capacity but need to confirm any customer-managed backups.)
- Do you need full raw disk forensic images or are timestamped metadata + deletion receipts sufficient for auditors?

I'll loop in Karthik to scope the ops run and confirm encryption key handling.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment placeholders: pinning-checklist.pdf, erase-sim-output.log]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-04T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pin & purge — what artifacts can you provide?

Tessa / team — quick ops notes and proposed acceptance criteria to include in the bundle:

- Verification artifacts we can produce automatically: fleet allocation export (JSON manifest), kube node placement snapshot, LB routing table at T+, and KV-cache purge events (audit rows).
- For purge simulation we will run a tenant-wipe job in a staging tenant that mirrors FinWell's config. That job outputs: job-run logs, per-object deletion receipts (with SHA256), and a signed event that our KMS records for the deletion transaction.
- Snapshots: we do hourly snapshots for Dedicated for a configurable window. By default, snapshots are region-local. If customer-configured cross-region replication exists, we need an explicit approval to run deletions there; otherwise our acceptance will assume no cross-region replication.
- Encryption keys: we can redact key material but will include key IDs and a signed key-rotation entry. If FinWell requires HSM-backed attestations, flag that now.

Attachments I'm adding for internal reference: [Attachment: sop_snapshot_rotate.txt (TXT, 6KB)].

Open questions for legal/compliance: what retention window does FinWell expect after a purge? Standard options we can offer: immediate evidence + 30 days of logs retained, or extended 12 month audit retention bundle (with additional fees).

I propose we run the staging wipe on Aug 6, collect artifacts by Aug 10, and package for Alice by Aug 11. Tessa — if FinWell confirms the snapshot replication posture, we can stick to this schedule.

-Karthik
Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference Ops

From: Alice Park <alice@finwell.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@finwell.com
Date: 2026-08-04T14:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pin & purge — what artifacts can you provide?

Tessa / Karthik — thanks for the detail. This looks good and the timeline is reasonable. A few clarifications from our side:

- We do not use cross-region snapshot replication today for any production customers, but procurement wants the vendor statement that you will not enable replication by default for our dedicated capacity. A short one-paragraph vendor attestation will suffice.
- For auditors, timestamped metadata + deletion receipts are sufficient — we do not need raw disk images.
- Please include the SOC2 control IDs that map to the wipe/snapshot controls if available.
- We will accept the 30-day log-retention option for audit evidence.

Procurement: we will send the signed PO via DocuSign by Aug 9; I will copy you. Once PO is in hand please proceed with the Aug 6 staging run.

Thanks,
Alice

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice@finwell.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-05T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pin & purge — what artifacts can you provide?

Alice — perfect, thank you. Recap and next steps:

Action items we will execute after receiving the PO / confirmation:
- Aug 6: Ops will execute the staging tenant wipe and capture logs, receipts, and signed deletion events. (Owner: Karthik)
- Aug 7–10: Ops will collate artifacts, scrub PII, and generate the vendor attestation paragraph confirming no default cross-region replication for your dedicated pool. (Owner: Ops)
- Aug 11: We will deliver the artifact bundle (pinning-checklist.pdf, erase-sim-output.log, sop_snapshot_rotate.txt) and a short mapping doc with SOC2 control IDs. Delivery via secure Share (link below) and email.

HubSpot / milestone: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9421
Delivery channel: secure share link + signed PDF; we can also provide a sealed S3 object if required.

If anything changes on your side (PO date, additional auditor asks), please flag immediately. Otherwise Karthik will start the run on Aug 6.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — inference that scales
[Deliverables will be uploaded to: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/finwell-dedicated-evidence-9421]
